about_short_description.short_description: ZiCON Cloud specializes in supply chain management, procurement, inventory management, manufacturing, and logistics and warehousing.

product.name: Supply Chain Management
product.description: A system for managing the flow of goods, information, and finances across the supply chain.

product.name: Procurement Management
product.description: A tool to manage purchasing processes, supplier relationships, and procurement workflows.

product.name: Inventory Management
product.description: A system to track, control, and optimize inventory levels and stock movements.

product.name: Manufacturing Management
product.description: A platform to plan, schedule, and monitor manufacturing processes and production workflows.

product.name: Logistics and Warehousing
product.description: A system to manage transportation, distribution, and warehouse operations.
